title: Cancelling a Marlowe & Finch Alterations Ticket
content:
**Clause.** A Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket can be cancelled at the customer's request only before the work starts, while the ticket is in dropped off status. On cancellation every charge on the ticket is waived as a cancellation before work, and every payment, including the deposit, is refunded to its tender. Once work has started the ticket cannot be cancelled: if the customer takes the garment back unfinished, the operations already completed are charged at the price list and the deposit is applied to them.

## By ticket status

| Status on the ticket | Cancellation at the customer's request | What happens to charges and payments |
|---|---|---|
| dropped off | possible | every charge waived as a cancellation before work; every payment, deposit included, refunded to its own tender |
| in progress (work has started) | not possible | if the garment is taken back unfinished: completed operations charged at the price list, the deposit applied to them |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A ticket in dropped off status carries two operation charges and a deposit paid by gift card. The customer cancels: both charges are waived and the deposit goes back to the gift card.
- A ticket in progress has one of its two operations completed when the customer asks for the garment back. The ticket is not cancelled; the completed operation is charged at the price list and the deposit is applied to it.
